title: Great night out historic tour flamenco and tapas.
text: Olga was informative and friendly   We enjoyed the tour immensely.  Even in the pouring rain she made it fun.
author: Elizabeth_R

title: Our tour was interesting, educational and beautiful!!  Our tour and tour guide Stephane were exceptional!
text: Our tour guide Stephanie was amazing!  She showed us places that we would probably not have gone without tour guide.  She also explained the history behind the locations in Barcelona.  She also gave up some ideas on things to do the following day on our own.  We would definitely request Stephanie if we were to come to Barcelona again!
author: Maria S

title: Old City
text: Our tour guide Stephanie was wonderful with so much historical and architectural knowledge to share.  The tour was the perfect length, and covered the layout of the old city.  The show and tapas/sangria were good and a nice way to end the tour.
author: Claudia_L

title: Excellent tour with amazing flamenco show
text: Marlon was fantastic. He offered an excellent insight of all attractions we visited, and was always willing to assist when required. The flamenco show was amazing. The flamenco place does not contain many guests and this was big extra
author: ALAN_B

title: GREAT EXPERIENCE
text: Tour guide was AMAZING!!!  He was very informative and took us on a quick walk around some of the historical and culture rich areas in the community.  Very educational , fun and relaxed all into one.  Guide was very flexible with allowing our group to stop when needed and pick up again as not to fall behind schedule.  Would highly recommend to ALL travelers in this area.  Flamenco show was on POINT and was such highlight as well.
author: Michael_K

title: Excellent tour, very laid...
text: Excellent tour, very laid back and flexible. Valentina was very knowledgeable and made us feel very comfortable
author: Joseph_V

title: Flaminco and tapas
text: Jordi was the perfect host. He knew the city and its history very well, along with a few if the locals. It was enchanting. I have never seen a Flaminco show and it did not disappoint, I wish it was even a bit longer. Jordi accompanied me to a hot chocolate afterwards on this rainy  evening. The perfect end 😊
author: Janette_O

title: Excellent experience, highly recommended
text: Very passionate flamenco show, great performance of dancers, guitar player and singer was also great.  Tapas in the bar and walking in the old city was in the friendly and funny atmosphere. We highly recommend Miguel, the best guide of In Out Barcelona tours, he gave us good advices as to our further stay and recommended the best restaurants in Barcelona.
author: lanaa607

title: Tapas and Flamenco Show
text: Patri gave us an amazing tour, we learned so much about the history and customs of Barcelona. She also gave us plenty of recommendations on places do go while in Barcelona. The Flamenco show was fantastic too! Highlights reccomend! Thanks again Patri!
author: Mary R

title: Fiorella: An Exceptional Delight!!!!
text: Our guide was Fiorella and was a font of fascinating, historical and cultural knowledge. We,( my 18 year old daughter and I), wished she could have been with us on our entire vacation. She told fascinating stories and spoke excellent English. The tapas stop was a bar called Craft which was also great! The bartenders/servers were friendly, engaging and genuinely welcoming - they didn’t make you feel like you were bothering them stopping in a tour in their place.
